health-feature.quote: Enhancing dental care due to the natural abrasive action of chewing

breed-size.quote: small dogs with a weight between 5 and 10kg

texts.about_this_item: 8in1 Delights Chicken Bone S is a knotted chew bone made of tasty beefhide with delicious chicken breast inside, giving intensive, long-lasting chewing fun for small dogs weighing 5–10 kg. While keeping your dog busy, the natural abrasive action of chewing helps remove tartar and supports dental health. Low in fat, rich in protein, oven baked, free from artificial colours and flavour enhancers, with no added sugar, GMOs or gluten. One bone, 35 g.
texts.feeding_instructions: Feed 1 treat over a course of three days. Do not exceed 1 treat in a three day period. Treats should not exceed 10% of your dog's daily caloric intake. Select a chew slightly larger than your pet's mouth. Always provide fresh water. Supervise your dog while chewing.
